purpose: Teach: エリート/特権/指向/リターン/置き換え/手がけ/財務省/おおむね

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: エリート出身者の指向、データ分析寄りだね。
lines.en: The elite-track people do tend to favor data analysis, don't they.
lines.style: Observational, measured tone. Light curiosity rather than criticism. Leans on the final word with subtle emphasis—confirming her own thinking aloud. Steady breath, no rush.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。古い手法を、おおむね新ツールに置き換えています。
lines.en: Yes. We're replacing most of the old methods with the new tools.
lines.style: Straightforward, factual delivery. Confident without being defensive. Slight nod in the voice—collaboration and forward motion. Clean articulation, professional ease.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 特権アカウントの管理、財務省監査でも問われた。
lines.en: Privileged-account management came up in the finance ministry audit too.
lines.style: Shifts to directive tone—firmer, more focused. Speaks as someone flagging a concern that matters. No apology in it, just clarity. Slight lift on 'too' to signal this connects to a pattern.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 手がけた改善で、リターンが見えています。
lines.en: The improvements we've implemented are already showing returns.
lines.style: Confident and slightly proud—not boastful. Steady eye-contact level in the voice. Concrete, evidence-based. Slight emphasis on 'already' to show tangible progress ahead of schedule.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.style: Brief, warm, affirming. Quiet authority—not a command, a trust. Exhales slightly on the period. Acknowledges his work without overdoing it. Like a small nod.
